rounds.text: Veerhealth Care Ltd demonstrates extraordinary top-line momentum, evidenced by a phenomenal 95% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E11] and screen reasons highlighting a staggering 198% year-over-year sales surge [E47], alongside consistent multi-year expansion of 31% over 10 years [E8], 25% over 5 years [E9], and 35% over 3 years [E10]. This powerful commercial acceleration is actively translating into bottom-line outperformance, marked by a robust 72% profit growth in the trailing twelve months [E15] and a positive signal where recent profit growth surpasses one-year price growth by 9% [E38]. Market participants are already rewarding this fundamental acceleration, as the stock trades near the very top of its 52-week range at 99% of its span [E5], supported by solid multi-year share price appreciation of 46% over five years [E17] and 63% over the past year [E19]. Conceded: the high trailing P/E multiple of 96.9x [E1], the modest ROE of 3.0% [E7], and the recent deceleration in earnings growth [E52].
